summary: Wood stairway tower in Aitkin County, built by the CCC per the Aitkin County tower report and dismantled in 1981; it stood a couple of miles west of the refuge office.

facts.design: Wood stairway tower with an observation cabin
facts.status_note: Dismantled in 1981, according to the report

access.note: The Rice Lake National Wildlife Refuge is open daily from sunrise to sunset, and visiting is free. No source describes the tower site itself.

events.note: Report narrative says the CCC built the lookout in 1940; its date table gives about 1947
Dismantled because it had deteriorated; a local citizen bought it for $1.00

notes_for_editor: Two conflicts left open: (1) the report's date table gives c. 1947 but its narrative says the CCC built the lookout in 1940; the story gives the narrative date and says the table differs. (2) The report puts the refuge about six miles south of McGregor; the refuge page says about five miles. The record's coordinates (46.53977, -93.32742) fit the refuge area. No source describes the tower site today. The refuge page is a current visitor page, so it supports only the access facts.
